# AI Data House

AI Data House is an AI transformation partner for growing US businesses.
We build custom web apps, workflow automations, AI chatbots, AI voice agents,
CRM automations, and live dashboards that replace manual operations and spreadsheets.

## What We Do

- AI Workflow Automation: replace manual steps with automated pipelines
- Custom Internal Web Apps: replace Google Sheets with purpose-built tools
- AI Chatbots: 24/7 lead qualification and customer support
- AI Voice Agents: missed-call recovery, appointment setting, restaurant ordering
- CRM and Lead Automation: speed-to-lead, CRM sync, follow-up sequences
- Data Dashboards and Reporting: live visibility across all business operations

## Industries We Serve

- Real Estate: speed-to-lead automation, CRM sync, agent dashboards
- E-commerce: order automation, inventory sync, fulfillment tracking
- Agencies: client reporting, lead routing, campaign automation
- Restaurants: AI phone ordering, reservation booking, missed-call recovery
- Professional Services: onboarding, document collection, invoicing automation
- Healthcare / Clinics: referral intake, appointment scheduling, HIPAA-aware data handling
